description: Before signing a payment from ANY wallet, run it through a line of TapeOut circuits on X Layer: each circuit's own eval/step answers yes or no, free and read-only. You supply the context a Fusebox wallet would keep on-chain. Pass the returned state back next time so latches (the Breaker) remember. Shipped fuses: 1 Daily Cap (a = cap per UTC day, USD₮0), 2 Payee Guard (a = cooling-off hours, b = trial USD₮0), 3 Breaker, 4 Two of Three (a = approvals above, USD₮0). If it says no, don't sign.

approvals.description: How many of three approvers signed this exact payment

hours_since_saved.description: Hours since the payee was saved

line.description: Fuses by registry id with their settings

rule.description: A ready-made rule by name instead of fuse_id, e.g. "daily-budget" (see fusebox_rules)

payee_saved.description: Is the payee in your payee book?

repeat_cleared.description: Repeat Guard: the owner cleared one repeat of this payment

same_payment_hours_ago.description: Repeat Guard: hours since this exact payment (payee and amount) last went out; omit if never

spent_today.description: USD₮0 already paid today through this line

state.description: Latch state from the previous pre-flight's state

name: fusebox_preflight
title: Pre-flight a payment against TapeOut circuits (any wallet)
